"'''Green Leader'''" was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]], he served as [[Green Leader|leader]] of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] and participated during the [[Battle of Atollon]] where he flew a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] and made bombing runs on one of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Star Destroyer]]s.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|season three]] finale "[[Zero Hour]]," where his voice was provided by [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Zero Hour" />
